Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.

O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparência, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. A Dexian está comprometida com a responsabilidade social corporativa e, investe em programas que apoiam a diversidade e inclusão.

Se você compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar!

O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho:

Atuar no planejamento, desenvolvimento e execução de estratégias de migração de dados para o projeto de Modernização do Sistema de Pricing e Rebates;

Analisar estruturas de dados legadas, realizando o mapeamento e a transformação dos dados para o novo schema em SQL Server;

Desenvolver scripts de carga, mapeamento e transformação de dados (ETL), incluindo migração de dados históricos, dados de clientes e dados condicionais;

Criar e executar scripts de validação de dados, assegurando precisão, integridade e qualidade das informações migradas;

Conduzir testes de migração, testes de performance e validações amostrais de dados;

Monitorar a execução das migrações, liderando troubleshooting e resolução de erros durante o processo;

Interagir diretamente com stakeholders técnicos e de negócio para alinhamento de cronograma, validações e aprovação final da migração;

Documentar procedimentos de migração, mapeamento de dados e resultados no Confluence;

Atuar de forma colaborativa com times multidisciplinares em ambiente ágil, promovendo melhoria contínua dos processos de migração.

O que você precisa ter:

Experiência sólida (8+ anos) em projetos de migração de dados e substituição de sistemas legados;

Forte experiência com processos ETL, transformação e validação de dados;

Domínio de SQL Server (design de schema, T-SQL, stored procedures, carga e validação de dados);

Experiência com ferramentas de ETL, como SSIS ou similares;

Experiência com linguagens de script como Python, PowerShell ou equivalentes;

Vivência com processamento e análise de arquivos Excel (incluindo parsing e estruturas legadas);

Conhecimento em análise de dados, data profiling, data quality assessment e tratamento de erros;

Experiência com versionamento de código (Git, Bitbucket ou similares);

Vivência com Jira e Confluence;

Boa comunicação para atuar com públicos técnicos e não técnicos;

Capacidade de organização, autonomia e priorização de demandas orientadas a projeto;

Inglês avançado.

Desejável:

Experiência com metodologias ágeis (Agile/Scrum) aplicadas a projetos de migração de dados;

Vivência com otimização de performance e escalabilidade em migração de dados;

Experiência com ferramentas e frameworks de qualidade de dados;

Experiência com sistemas de pricing, rebates, workflow ou ambientes corporativos complexos;

title: Senior Graphic Web Designer
description:
About the Role

You’ll be our core design lead, working closely with strategy, growth and creative direction. You’ll shape ideas and also execute them — from campaign concepts to ads, landing pages and newsletters.

This is a hands-on role with real creative ownership.

What You’ll Do Campaigns & Marketing Systems
  • Translate strategy into clear, strong creative concepts across digital and offline channels
  • Design campaign assets with a defined role in the funnel and customer journey
  • Create ad visuals for digital channels (Meta, Google, display, social)
  • Regularly design offline assets such as posters, flyers, brochures, and OOH for selected clients
  • Ensure offline and digital assets feel part of one coherent system
  • Think in systems: how ideas, formats, and visuals repeat, adapt, and scale
Brand & Digital Design
  • Design and evolve brand systems rather than isolated assets
  • Create website and landing page visuals focused on clarity, structure, and conversion
  • Ensure consistency across brand, campaigns, CRM, web, and physical materials
  • Work with developers or page builders to ensure designs are implemented correctly
Email & CRM Design
  • Design newsletters and email journeys as part of a wider marketing system
  • Build or adapt emails using HTML templates or ESP editors
  • Design within real-world email constraints (responsiveness, compatibility)
  • Create reusable visual patterns for CRM and lifecycle communications
UX-Minded Design
  • Apply UX thinking to websites, landing pages, and marketing funnels
  • Create wireframes, flows, or structural layouts when helpful
  • Design for understanding, usability, and decision-making — not decoration
  • Apply UX principles to offline materials where they guide behaviour or action
What We’re Looking For Must-haves
  • 5+ years’ experience as a designer (agency, studio, or in-house)
  • Minimum B2 level of English
  • A strong portfolio showing thoughtful digital and campaign work
  • Excellent graphic design fundamentals (layout, typography, hierarchy)
  • Experience designing across digital and offline touchpoints
  • Solid understanding of performance-driven and conversion-aware design
  • Working knowledge of HTML for emails/newsletters (no full development required)
  • UX awareness and user-centred thinking
  • Ability to work autonomously, take ownership, and make sound creative decisions
  • Availability to work closer to European time
Nice-to-haves
  • UX/UI project experience
  • Experience working in sprints or agile environments
  • Motion basics (After Effects, Lottie, simple animations)
  • Experience with Figma and Adobe CC
  • Interest in systems, automation, or marketing infrastructure
How We Work
  • Small, senior-led team
  • High trust, low bureaucracy
  • Clear briefs and clear expectations
  • Direct client impact and visibility
  • Specialists brought in when needed — you’re not expected to do everything
What We Offer
  • A central creative role with real influence on how BLND works
  • Space to think, not just produce
  • A mix of strategic, digital, and offline projects
  • Flexible working (fully remote)
  • Competitive compensation, based on experience
  • Opportunity to grow into a broader creative leadership role as BLND scales
About BLND

BLND is a marketing engineering agency working with B2B2C companies that don’t have large in-house marketing teams but need structure, clarity, and systems before they scale.

We help businesses connect their business buyers, partners, and end customers through well-designed marketing systems. That means strategy, CRM, automation, data flows, websites, campaigns, and — where relevant — offline materials that all work together.

We don’t focus on producing more content.

We focus on designing how marketing actually works .

Founded in 2023, BLND builds on over 12 years of experience across strategy, design, marketing, and technology. We work in small, senior teams, value clear thinking over noise, and care deeply about quality, ownership, and long-term impact.

title: Lead Backend Engineer (Python) — Silicon Valley Healthcare AI Company (Remote, Latin America)
description:
You have been the go-to engineer on your team — the one others turn to when things get hard. You don't wait for tickets; you figure out what needs to be built and you build it. Now you want a role where that's the expectation, not the exception.

We're hiring for that role. Remote, anywhere in Latin America.

Areti Health is a fast-growing Silicon Valley healthcare technology company. We have built the only full-service clinical trial patient recruitment AI agent. Backed by leading venture capital firms with a $6.6M funding round just closed, we are on a mission to transform clinical research through technology that allows pharmaceutical, biotech, and medical device companies to bring their therapies to patients faster and save lives.

We achieve industry-leading conversion rates: up to 10x improvement over human-driven processes with up to 8x operational cost reduction. Coupled with our seamless medical record access and mass outreach capabilities, we compress recruitment timelines from many months to a few weeks across multiple therapeutic areas.

Our AI-first system matches prospective patients, answers their questions based on clinical trial documentation using voice and chat AI, schedules appointments, collects patient information, runs pre-qualification questionnaires, assists with patient onboarding, nurtures scheduled patients, and integrates with research site systems – all fully autonomously. We work with some of the largest US clinical research players, including the #1 commercial clinical research organization ($16B in revenue), the #1 academic clinical research organization (trials at 1,100 sites), and the #1 clinical research site network.

You will join a team of 20, working closely with the founder who brings a prior $4B healthcare technology exit, Y Combinator founder experience, a Stanford PhD, and three Silicon Valley CTO stints.

We offer competitive salary, stock options, and paid time off.

What you will do

  • Scale the product to support thousands of clinical trials
  • Work directly on AI applications daily
  • Design, develop, and maintain reliable, simple, and efficient Python services
  • Architect and implement robust backend systems that handle sensitive healthcare data
  • Collaborate cross-functionally to deliver solutions that delight customers
  • Deeply integrate with clinical trial management and other systems
  • Write clean, maintainable, and well-tested code
  • Drive technical and product decision-making and help shape our engineering roadmap and architecture decisions

Note: This role does not involve training ML models.

Requirements

  • You are excited about our mission: getting novel therapies to patients faster
  • 5+ years of Python experience you're proud of — across multiple projects, systems, or problem domains. We value growth and range, not the same year repeated five times.
  • Track record of end-to-end ownership: scoping, building, shipping, and maintaining
  • You are an AI-native developer — you ship features using Claude Code, Codex, or similar tools daily, not occasionally
  • Comfortable navigating ambiguity and taking initiative. You figure out what needs to be done – not expect to be told what to do
  • Self-directed and low-maintenance thanks to your strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail 
  • Background as a software engineer first — we're looking for candidates who have focused their careers on building and shipping production software, rather than transitioning from data science, research, or other adjacent fields
  • BS in Computer Science or equivalent

Nice to have

  • AWS infrastructure experience
  • Experience with large language models in production, where you personally wrote prompts and used GenAI tooling, such as prompting or guardrail libraries

  • Webhooks: Experiência prática no recebimento e envio de dados via webhooks.
  • Lógica de Programação: Forte capacidade analítica para estruturar condicionais, loops e transformações de dados.

Millions of scientists, educators and students use JoVE for their research, teaching and learning. Our institutional clients comprise over 1,000 universities, colleges, and biopharma companies, including such leaders as Harvard, MIT, Yale and Stanford. As a rapidly growing company, with offices in the USA, UK, Australia, and India servicing clients in over 60 countries, we are seeking talented and ambitious individuals to join our company.

The Role

As a Customer Success Specialist, you will help professors at leading universities in the US integrate JoVE videos into their courses to improve teaching outcomes and student success. You'll play a key role in ensuring users get the most value from their JoVE subscription.

Responsibilities:

  • Conduct daily outreach to Faculty (via calls, emails, and 1:1 demos) to set up JoVE integrations in courses and increase product usage.
  • Increase JoVE adoption by delivering product awareness sessions across existing customer universities and research institutes.
  • Grow engagement and usage by delivering presentations at (1) exhibits and conferences, (2) university seminars and workshops, and (3) onsite customer visits.
  • Strengthen subscription renewal outcomes by ensuring smooth implementation support, and consistent usage of JoVE resources.
  • Influence product decisions by communicating customer feedback to sales, product, and marketing teams.

Requirements:

  • A Master's degree or PhD in Life Science disciplines.
  • 1 to 2 years of experience in sales or business development, preferably in EdTech, SAAS or STEM publishing.
  • Experience in science communications, academic outreach or other customer-facing roles is preferred.
  • Fluent communication skills English.
  • Knowledge of education, market trends, and challenges in assigned content areas i.e. Biology, Chemistry, Medicine, Physics, Engineering, or Psychology.
  • Strong interpersonal skills with a passion for remote relationship-building.
  • Experience in networking using cold calling is preferred.

Please share your resume in English.

Why Join JoVE?

  • You can expect compensation packages competitively placed within the local market.
  • You will make a direct impact in accelerating science research and in improving student learning in science education.
  • Opportunity to work with global teams and in an environment that promotes innovation and collaboration.
  • Our strong promotion from within culture draws a clear path to advance your career with us.

About the client

The client operates in the health and information services domain, with a strong focus on enabling data-driven decision-making at enterprise scale. Their mission centers on building a modern, cloud-based data platform that serves as a single source of truth for business intelligence, analytics, machine learning, and AI use cases. The culture emphasizes data quality, governance, scalability, and collaboration across engineering, analytics, and business stakeholders.

About the role

This role is focused on building and operating a robust data platform on Azure using Databricks. The engineer will play a key part in DataOps, ensuring data completeness, accuracy, and reliability across enterprise-scale pipelines. You will design monitoring frameworks, implement data quality checks, and support governance initiatives. The role is highly collaborative, working closely with data engineers, analysts, and stakeholders. It also requires strong ownership and the ability to operate independently in a fast-paced environment.

Responsibilities

  • Design and develop a robust monitoring stack for jobs executed in Azure Data Factory, Databricks, MS Fabric, and other platform tools
  • Assist in building and maintaining data catalogs in Unity Catalog and Purview
  • Design and implement a scalable framework for data quality checks across hundreds of columns on large datasets
  • Monitor data completeness and accuracy to ensure published data meets acceptable criteria
  • Collaborate with data engineers, analysts, and stakeholders to deliver high-quality data solutions
  • Troubleshoot and optimize big data workflows for performance and scalability
  • Support governance and oversight of data pipelines and transformation activities
  • Stay current with emerging technologies and best practices in big data and analytics

Must have skills

  • 7+ years of overall experience in Data Engineering / DataOps
  • 5+ years of professional software development experience in a Databricks environment (any cloud)
  • Strong experience with DataOps practices
  • Strong experience with data catalogs
  • Strong experience implementing data quality checks at scale
  • Strong Python experience
  • Strong proficiency in Data Governance processes and tools
  • Experience with Purview and/or Unity Catalog
  • Advanced SQL skills
  • Solid understanding of data structures, algorithms, and distributed computing
  • Experience with ETL processes, data cleaning, and large-scale data transformation
  • Ability to work independently and manage priorities in a fast-paced environment
  • Excellent problem-solving skills with an analytics-driven mindset
  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience

Nice to have skills

  • Experience with Azure cloud services (preferred)
  • Experience with AWS
  • Experience with GCP
  • Familiarity with version control systems such as Git
  • Experience with DevOps practices

Conditions

  • 100% Remote role , primarily aligned to UTC-5 (EST) with a minimum of 5 hours overlap required
  • Contractor role – 6-month contract, renewable based on budget and performance
  • Full-time dedication (40 hours/week)
  • BYOD requirement

4) Análise de projetos e estudos técnicos de outras empresas, bem como a emissão de Pareceres Técnicos (PATEC) de equipamentos e serviços que envolvam equipamento Emerson;

5) Serviços para configuração, programação e atualização (i.e. softwares, ladder, hardware, firmware, etc) dos Sistemas de Automação Emerson das Instalações de Produção da PETROBRAS, englobando computadores, redes de comunicação de dados e equipamentos de controle e intertravamento, tais como controladores lógicos programáveis da Emerson (PACSystems RX3i, Versamax, Series 9030 e 9070);

6) Gerenciamento, monitoração e suporte para supervisórios da GE Digital (implementados ou não em conjunto com PLC da Emerson);

7) Elaboração, desenvolvimento e execução de projetos de migração de sistemas com equipamentos Emerson descontinuados (obsoletos);

8) Realizar auditoria técnica nos equipamentos e aplicativos do fabricante, assim como gerenciamento e planejamento de sobressalentes e estoque de equipamentos dos Sistemas de Automação Industrial Emerson;

9) Comissionamento de novas tecnologias para os sistemas Emerson de Automação Industrial.

Você toma ações consistentes para desenvolver novas habilidades. Você antecipa conflitos antes que aconteçam, com base no conhecimento sobre dinâmicas interpessoais e de grupo. Você antecipa as necessidades do cliente e oferece serviços que vão além das expectativas dele. Você fornece informações úteis e no momento certo para pessoas em toda a organização. Você age de forma rápida e decisiva em situações imprevisíveis e que mudam rapidamente.

Para este cargo, você precisará:

  • Conhecimento avançado no pacote MS Office;
  • Desejável conhecimento do portfólio de produtos da Emerson, tais como: PACSystems RX3i, VersaMax, QuickPanel+, Machine Edition e etc;
  • Capacidade de especificar, dar suporte e manutenção, e elaborar arquiteturas de redes de automação industrial envolvendo switches, firewalls e rádios industriais;
  • Disponibilidade para viagens para visitar instalações e escritórios do cliente;
  • Disponibilidade para trabalho embarcado em plataformas de petróleo, no regime de trabalho 14 x 14;
  • Local de trabalho: Rio de Janeiro – RJ;
  • Idiomas: Português e Inglês avançado.

Nossa cultura e compromisso com você:

Na Emerson, priorizamos um local de trabalho onde todos os colaboradores sejam valorizados, respeitados e capacitados para crescer. Promovemos um ambiente que incentiva a inovação, a colaboração e perspectivas diversas, porque sabemos que grandes ideias vêm de grandes equipes. Seja por meio de orientação, treinamento ou oportunidades de liderança, investimos no seu sucesso para que você possa causar um impacto duradouro. description:
A Atos é uma líder global em transformação digital, com cerca de 94.000 colaboradores e uma receita anual de aproximadamente €11 bilhões de euros. Número um na Europa em cibersegurança, nuvem e computação de alto desempenho, o Grupo oferece soluções personalizadas de ponta a ponta para todos os setores em 69 países. Pioneira em serviços e produtos de descarbonização, a Atos está comprometida com um ambiente digital seguro e descarbonizado para seus clientes. A Atos é uma SE (Societas Europaea) e está listada na Euronext Paris.

Gerente Soluções – SAP

Local: Híbrido 2 vezes por semana em São Paulo (Capital).

Horário: 09:00 – 18:00.

Buscamos Gerente Soluções SAP Sênior, para integrar nosso time de pré-vendas. O profissional atuará em apoio direto à área comercial, definindo estratégias técnicas, coordenando entregas e garantindo propostas competitivas e aderentes às necessidades dos clientes.

Responsabilidades:

  • Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com a equipe de vendas para identificar oportunidades e desenvolver estratégias SAP para os clientes;
  • Realizar apresentações técnicas e demonstrações de produtos para clientes potenciais, destacando benefícios e funcionalidades das soluções SAP;
  • Avaliar e compreender os requisitos SAP dos clientes e oferecer recomendações de soluções adequadas;
  • Colaborar com as equipes de engenharia e desenvolvimento para garantir que as soluções oferecidas atendam às necessidades dos clientes;
  • Elaborar custeio e precificação de soluções SAP, garantindo competitividade e adequação ao mercado;
  • Compreender e gerenciar o ciclo de venda, desde a identificação de oportunidades até o fechamento de contratos;
  • Desenvolver propostas técnicas e comerciais para empresas públicas e privadas, garantindo o cumprimento dos requisitos regulatórios e das especificações do cliente;
  • Apoiar o desenvolvimento de propostas técnicas e documentos de resposta a RFPs/RFIs;
  • Manter-se atualizado com as tendências e tecnologias em SAP e disseminar conhecimento na equipe.

Requisitos:

  • Experiência comprovada em SAP, preferencialmente com atuação em pré-venda;
  • Experiência em elaboração de propostas para empresas públicas e privadas;
  • Atuação comprovada como mandatário de delivery (responsável pela coordenação/entrega de projetos) ou Consultor SAP nas áreas logística (MM/SD/WM/Transportation) ou financeira (FI/CO), com forte conhecimento dos processos de negócio;
  • Conhecimentos sólidos de integração de sistemas, gestão de dados e conformidade regulatória em ambientes SAP;
  • Experiência com provedores de nuvem/hyperscalers (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud) em ambientes de nuvem pública;
  • Vivência com parceiros tecnológicos e integradores no mercado brasileiro;
  • Formação superior em Tecnologia da Informação, Engenharia da Computação, Administração, Contabilidade, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas correlatas será diferencial;
  • Inglês avançado (leitura, escrita e conversação) — uso cotidiano;
  • Certificações relevantes em SAP serão consideradas diferencial;
  • Capacidade para trabalhar de forma autônoma e colaborativa;
  • Habilidade para comunicar conceitos técnicos de forma clara a públicos técnicos e executivos;
  • Disponibilidade para viagens conforme necessário.

Benefícios:

  • Vale refeição ou Vale alimentação;
  • Plano de saúde extensível a cônjuge e filhos;
  • Plano odontológico;
  • Programa de remuneração variável;
  • Auxílio creche - conforme regras sindicais da localidade;

  • Empréstimo Consignado (após 1 ano de empresa);
  • Convênio com empresas parceiras (Descontos para realização de graduação, pós-graduação, MBA e Idiomas);
  • Política de Subsídios para Pós-graduação, MBAs e Certificações (A Atos apoia o seu desenvolvimento, subsidiando financeiramente ações externas);
  • Speexx (curso online de até 5 idiomas gratuitamente)
  • Programa de treinamentos internos e externos;

  • Espaço Saúde (suporte com atendimento médico - presencial ou online - para os funcionários e seus familiares e contamos também com os programas de bem-estar e qualidade de vida);

title: Estagiário de direito
description:
Resumo:

O estagiário atuará presencialmente no Brooklin Paulista, São Paulo -SP, em uma função estratégica, dando suporte às operações jurídicas através da organização eficiente de documentos em nuvem, confecção de peças jurídicas de média a alta complexidade, acompanhamento de prazos e gestão de processos através do sistema PROJURIS ADV, diligências externas e atendimento aos clientes.

Atribuições Principais:

  • Gestão de Documentos em Nuvem: Organização e arquivamento de documentos jurídicos em plataformas de armazenamento em nuvem. Criação e manutenção de estruturas de pastas e subpastas para uma organização eficiente dos arquivos.
  • Atendimento ao Cliente: Atendimento aos clientes, esclarecendo dúvidas, fornecendo informações sobre o andamento dos processos e coletando documentos necessários. Elaboração e envio de informações relevantes aos clientes. Atualização dos atendimentos aos clientes no sistema Projuris.

  • Gerenciamento de Processos: Solicitação de documentos faltantes para a elaboração de petições iniciais e cumprimento de ordens judiciais. Peticionamento inicial e intermediário nos sistemas judiciais, como PJE, E-Saj, EPROC, PROJUDI, etc..
  • Diligências Externas: Realização de diligências externas quando necessário, como coleta e envio de documentos ou informações em órgãos públicos ou privados.
  • Outras atividades: Apoio em tarefas administrativas gerais da área jurídica, como controle de prazos, agendamento de reuniões e organização de arquivos físicos.

Perfil Desejado:

  • Organização e Atenção aos Detalhes: Capacidade de organizar grandes volumes de dados de forma eficiente e precisa.
  • Comunicação: Habilidade de se comunicar de forma clara e objetiva, tanto por escrito quanto verbalmente, para atender às demandas dos clientes e colegas de trabalho.
  • Proatividade: Iniciativa para identificar e resolver problemas, buscando sempre otimizar os processos.
  • Relacionamento Interpessoal: Facilidade em trabalhar em equipe e construir relacionamentos sólidos com clientes e colegas.
  • Domínio de Ferramentas Digitais: Conhecimento em ferramentas de organização de documentos em nuvem (como Google Drive, Dropbox, etc.) e softwares de produtividade (como Microsoft Office).
  • Deverá estar cursando : Curso de Direito, preferencialmente a partir do 7º semestre.

Benefícios:

  • Bolsa-estágio em valor equivalente ao mercado.
  • Vale transporte.
  • Seguro de vida.
  • Oportunidade de crescimento profissional em um ambiente dinâmico e desafiador.
  • Possibilidade de aprender e desenvolver novas habilidades.

- Experiência comprovada com GoLang no desenvolvimento backend;

- Experiência em otimização de performance front-end e back-end.

O foco principal será lidar com datasets complexos, realizar análises exploratórias (EDA) para identificar padrões ou anomalias e estruturar dados para visualização e modelagem. Você trabalhará em conjunto com desenvolvedores e especialistas do agronegócio para transformar dados brutos em inteligência.

Local: Av. Brigadeiro Faria Lima – São Paulo (Presencial)

Modelo de contratação: PJ

Responsabilidades

  • Executar processos de limpeza, transformação e validação de datasets, garantindo a qualidade e consistência da informação.

  • Criar análises e relatórios para suportar a tomada de decisão das áreas de negócio.
  • Utilizar Excel para validações rápidas e prototipação de análises.
  • Colaborar com o time de engenharia para otimizar a coleta e o armazenamento de dados.

Requisitos

  • Ensino Superior completo em áreas de exatas ou tecnologia (ex: Engenharia, Ciência da Computação, Estatística, Matemática , etc.).
  • Domínio de SQL para extração e manipulação de bancos de dados relacionais.
  • Conhecimento avançado em Excel .
  • Experiência prática com Python voltado para dados (bibliotecas como Pandas, NumPy).
  • Forte experiência em validação de dados e garantia de qualidade (Data Quality).
  • Capacidade de realizar análises exploratórias (EDA) de forma autônoma.
  • Perfil analítico, com atenção aos detalhes e habilidade de resolução de problemas.

Diferenciais

  • Vivência no setor do agronegócio ou indústrias correlatas.
  • Experiência com dados geoespaciais (GIS).
  • Noções de estatística descritiva.

O que oferecemos

  • Remuneração compatível com o mercado.
  • Ambiente colaborativo e tecnicamente desafiador.
  • Participação ativa em decisões de produto e estratégia de dados.
  • Oportunidade de crescimento em uma startup em expansão.

title: Mainframe Automation Engineer (zOS automation / Tivoli)
description:
ITTConnect is seeking a Senior Mainframe Systems Automation Engineer (zOS Automation and CA OPS/MVS) to work remotely for a client in the US. This is a potentially long term position with a client that is a global leader in consulting, digital transformation, technology and engineering services present in nearly 50 countries. This client is working with one of the major players in the mainframe technology and tools area.

Job location : Remote, work from home anywhere in Brazil .

All interviews will be in English only (must be professionally fluent).

We are seeking an experienced Senior Mainframe Automation Engineer to lead the migration and optimization of mainframe automation solutions. This role focuses on transitioning from CA OPS/MVS to IBM Tivoli Systems Automation for z/OS and from CA Automation Point to IBM Systems Automation for Integrated Operations Management (SAIOM) . The successful candidate will play a critical role in ensuring operational efficiency, system availability, and seamless automation processes within a complex z/OS environment.

You will collaborate closely with the Automation team to implement policy-based automation solutions, reduce administrative overhead, and enhance system responsiveness. This position does not impact application development but will significantly influence automation strategies and operations.

Job responsibilities :

  • Lead migration projects from CA OPS/MVS to IBM Tivoli Systems Automation for z/OS and CA Automation Point to IBM SAIOM.
  • Configure and implement IBM Systems Automation solutions, including policy-based automation for z/OS environments.
  • Develop and maintain automation rules, REXX execs, and System Automation Policy Database (PDB) configurations.
  • Provide installation and configuration assistance for IBM automation products.
  • Collaborate with operations teams to optimize system startup, shutdown, and recovery processes.
  • Ensure high availability and efficiency of critical systems through proactive automation strategies.
  • Document processes, configurations, and migration steps; deliver clear communication to stakeholders.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve automation-related issues in production environments.

Key skills :

  • Mainframe Operations Expertise: Minimum 5+ years in a mainframe operations environment in an operational, service, consultancy, or support role.
  • IBM Tivoli Systems Automation for z/OS: Advanced knowledge and hands-on experience.
  • TSO and ISPF: Proficient in using these tools for system management.
  • JCL: Strong skills in Job Control Language.
  • REXX Programming: Ability to write and maintain REXX scripts.
  • System Automation Policy Database (PDB): Working knowledge required.
  • Migration Experience: Proven track record in z/OS automation migration projects.
  • NetView for z/OS: Experience in implementing and using this product.

Preferred Skills and Proficiencies:

  • Knowledge of other IBM Z software, including system operation, configuration, and automation.
  • Familiarity with z/OS system startup and shutdown processes.
  • Experience with SMP/E for software installation and maintenance.
  • Understanding of competing automation products in the mainframe space.
  • Expertise in fully automated system configurations on IBM Z.

title: Remote Data Scientist (ML) - 52621
description:
About Turing:

Turing is one of the world’s fastest-growing AI companies accelerating the advancement and deployment of powerful AI systems. Turing helps customers in two ways: Working with the world’s leading AI labs to advance frontier model capabilities in thinking, reasoning, coding, agentic behavior, multimodality, multilinguality, STEM and frontier knowledge; and leveraging that work to build real-world AI systems that solve mission-critical priorities for companies.

Role Overview:

We’re looking for a Data Scientist who has excellent hands on Python skills and Machine Learning experience — someone who lives and breathes code, optimizes for performance, and has proven mastery on competitive programming or data challenge platforms like LeetCode, Codeforces, HackerRank, or Kaggle . In this role you will be working with Turing team members and AI researchers at Frontier Labs to devise techniques and build data sets to improve performance of models.

What You’ll Do:

  • Build, test, and optimize high-performance Python systems used in large-scale AI and data pipelines.
  • Design and maintain modular, clean, and production-ready Python codebases.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams (data, infra, and research engineers) to deliver reliable backend components.
  • Write efficient, maintainable, and testable code with strong focus on algorithms and data structures .
  • Stay current with modern Python tools, frameworks, ML advancements and best practices.

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field.
  • 4+ years of professional experience writing Python in production environments.
  • Expert-level proficiency in Python and core libraries (Pandas, NumPy, AsyncIO, Pytorch, Transformers, or similar).
  • Proven track record on coding platforms — e.g., top percentile or strong rating on LeetCode, Codeforces, HackerRank, or Kaggle competitions.
  • Experience with system design, clean architecture, and performance optimization.
  • Working level Proficiency in either Machine Learning or Data Science for Machine Learning.

Bonus:

  • Recognized performance in Kaggle , Codeforces , or ICPC/TopCoder contests.
  • Deep curiosity for performance tuning, scalability, and elegant code design.

Perks of Freelancing with Turing:

  • Work fully remotely, from anywhere.
  • Collaborate with world-class AI labs and frontier research companies .
  • Tackle real engineering challenges with high autonomy and ownership.

Offer Details:

  • Commitment: Minimum 20 hours/week with 4-hour PST overlap (options: 20, 30, or 40 hrs/week).
  • Type: Contractor (no medical/paid leave).
  • Duration: 3 months (start date: next week).

Evaluation Process:

  1. Technical Interview (60 mins): discussion of Python problem-solving, architecture, and system design.

After applying, you’ll receive a login link by email. Please complete your profile promptly so we can proceed with your application.

We’re actively hiring for this role. If you know exceptional talent, please refer them at and earn money for successful referrals.

title: Professor de inglês
description:
Faça parte da comunidade de professores que está transformando o ensino de idiomas no Brasil!

Onde os influencers do Brasil fazem suas aulas particulares!

A Idioma Independente , referência em inovação no ensino de idiomas, está buscando pessoas proativas, com perfil proativo e fluência em um segundo idioma, que querem ter sucesso no âmbito profissional, para se credenciar como professores e fazer parte da nossa comunidade engajada.

Aqui, você não será apenas mais um perfil online: você será parte de uma rede colaborativa com mais de 400 professores e 4.000 alunos que vivenciam nossa metodologia transformadora hoje, além de mais de 1000 professores e 10.000 alunos que já fizeram parte desta história.

Nos últimos 12 meses tivemos mais de 22 mil alunos interessados em fazer aulas conosco. Professores novos têm lotado suas agendas em até 30 dias, quando são comprometidos, se comunicam de forma eficaz e tem agenda no horário da noite disponível.

*Esta não é uma vaga CLT*

O que oferecemos?

  • Capacitação intensiva para melhoria no ensino de aulas de acordo com a nossa metodologia inovadora
  • Acesso exclusivo a uma plataforma com mais de 400 vídeos de treinamento, baseada em uma metodologia que já entregou resultados incríveis, com vídeos totalmente atualizados .
  • Mentorias semanais com especialistas experientes, que já treinaram mais de 1500 profissionais.
  • Plataforma exclusiva para acompanhamento das aulas.
  • Participação no nosso processo de captação de alunos, com possibilidade de ganhos adicionais relevantes, bastando você se interessar.
  • Descontos exclusivos em cursos de idiomas e viagens com a nossa comunidade.
  • Possibilidade de desenvolvimento e mentoria para ser um empreendedor de sucesso (se você quiser).
  • Um banco de aulas com mais de 800 aulas para facilitar o seu processo de construção de aulas.
  • Certificações dos treinamentos feitos dentro da comunidade que garantem que você obterá mais resultados juntos aos seus alunos e que agregam na sua carreira como professor independente.

Como saber se você é a pessoa certa para fazer parte da maior comunidade de professores independentes do Brasil?

Se você tem grandes ambições para impactar a educação no Brasil, acredita que o ensino de idiomas precisa de inovação, quer otimizar sua agenda de aulas e, ainda, gostaria de crescer como empreendedor, este é o lugar certo para você .

Necessário:

  • Maior de 18 anos , fluente em Português e outro idioma.
  • Disponibilidade de ao menos 20 horas semanais para treinamentos, aulas e ações práticas Esta é uma necessidade para obter os maiores retornos que a comunidade pode te proporcionar.
  • Possibilidade de participar em capacitações durante a semana, no turno da manhã ou tarde.
  • Independência para executar atividades, espírito de colaboração e vontade de contribuir para uma comunidade.

O diferencial?

Aqui você é mais que um professor.

Você será parte de uma comunidade de professores no ensino de idiomas , onde o trabalho colaborativo é a base para alcançar resultados de mercado altamente competitivos.

Esta não é uma vaga CLT , mas sim uma oportunidade de empreender e ser dono do seu crescimento com total suporte e estrutura de uma empresa inovadora.

Você cria laços e relações de confiança com pessoas que realmente se esforçam para te ajudar no seu desenvolvimento, devido ao modelo de negócio inovador que proporciona relações colaborativas e efetivas.

Se você tem vontade de fazer diferente e de vivenciar algo novo na sua história profissional, a ii com certeza é o seu lugar.

Faça parte da mudança no ensino de idiomas. Junte-se à Idioma Independente e transforme sua carreira e a vida de milhares de alunos!

O que eu faço?

  • Recebo capacitação para dar a melhor aula experimental da sua vida
  • Recebo capacitação em nossa metodologia, aprendendo como transformar a vida de muitos alunos, entregando resultado para eles/as
  • Recebo treinamentos e capacitações recorrentes com mentores experientes e especializados
  • Organizo e escolho a minha agenda e os horários que gostaria de ter alunos/as
  • Preparo aulas para os meus alunos/as
  • Dou as aulas para os meus alunos/as

Se você quiser ir além, também será possível, basta você se engajar na comunidade e aprender mais sobre todas as áreas do seu negócio.

QUANTO EU RECEBO POR ISSO?

  • Se você for somente professor, se dedicando 40h na semana a aulas, você poderá receber até R$4.000,00 por mês.
  • Se você quiser aprender sobre diferentes áreas e se engajar na comunidade, você pode construir uma renda mensal de até R$6.000,00 por mês em aproximadamente 1 ano.
  • Se você realmente quiser crescer e se desenvolver, se dedicando de forma integral junto da comunidade é possível chegar até R$12.000,00 por mês em 2 anos.

Tudo isso só dependerá de você, se quiser aprender mais sobre as partes comerciais e sobre como se tornar um mentor/a de professores.

Seja diferente, seja independente

✅ Work fully remote from anywhere

title: Windows Architect / Azure Infrastructure Architect

Azure & Cloud Architecture

Windows & Infrastructure Expertise

  • Windows File & Print Services
  • DNS, DHCP, WINS administration
  • DFS configuration and management
  • Windows Server upgrades and migrations
  • Backup and restoration (OS and data)

  • Collaborate with internal stakeholders, customers, and project managers to understand requirements and deliver solutions.

  • Participate in post-project reviews , capturing lessons learned and driving continuous improvement.

Required Skills & Experience

  • 13+ years of overall IT experience.
  • 5+ years of hands-on experience in Azure Infrastructure (IaaS/PaaS).
  • Strong experience across Azure Networking, Azure IAM, Azure Key Vault, Storage, Security, SIAM, and DC environments .
  • Proven experience migrating on-prem workloads to Azure .
  • Experience working in regulated industries such as Banking, Healthcare, or Insurance .
  • Ability to work in 24×7 support environments and flexible shifts.

Secondary / Nice-to-Have Skills

  • Design of Business Continuity and Disaster Recovery (BC/DR) solutions.
  • Exposure to identity, governance, and monitoring solutions in Azure.
  • Experience in multi-domain enterprise environments .

Certifications (Preferred)

  • AZ-104 – Microsoft Azure Administrator

Soft Skills

  • Strong customer-facing skills and ability to present solution designs.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
  • Positive attitude and strong team collaboration.
  • Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills.

title: UX Researcher (Mid-Level)
description:
We are looking for a curious, empathetic, and data-driven UX Researcher to join our team at Edward Martin. With at least 3 years of experience, you will be the bridge between our users and our product strategy. You will lead end-to-step research initiatives—from defining the problem to delivering actionable insights that influence design and engineering.

The ideal candidate is a master of qualitative methods, particularly In-Depth Interviews (IDIs) , and has a proven track record of synthesizing complex data into Personas and Critical User Journeys (CUJs) .

Key Responsibilities

  • End-to-End Research: Lead the planning, recruitment, execution, and analysis of qualitative research studies.
  • Qualitative Mastery: Conduct high-impact IDIs to uncover deep-seated user needs, pain points, and motivations.
  • Strategic Artifacts: Translate raw data into foundational design tools, including robust User Personas and detailed Critical User Journeys (CUJs) that map the user’s path across touchpoints.
  • Collaboration: Work closely with Product Designers and Product Managers to identify research gaps and ensure findings are integrated into the product roadmap.
  • Insight Evangelism: Present findings through compelling storytelling to stakeholders, moving beyond "what happened" to "why it matters" and "what we should do next."
  • Research tool: Familiar with research tools such as UserTesting, Dscout, Qualtrics, Google Drive, etc.

Minimum Qualifications

  • 3+ years of professional experience as a UX Researcher or Product Researcher.
  • Expertise in qualitative methodologies , specifically moderating interviews and conducting thematic analysis.
  • Proven ability to map Critical User Journeys that highlight friction points and opportunities.
  • Experience building and maintaining User Personas that are used by cross-functional teams to make decisions.
  • Portfolio or case studies demonstrating how your research directly impacted a product's direction.
  • Fluent in English, with excellent communication skills for both research and share-out purposes.

Preferred "Plus" Skills

  • Quantitative Proficiency: Experience designing, launching, and analyzing quantitative surveys to validate qualitative findings or measure user sentiment at scale.

Who You Are

  • You are a critical thinker who doesn't just take requests but asks "What is the core question we are trying to answer?"
  • You are an excellent communicator who can tailor your delivery to both designers and executives.
  • You are organized and capable of managing multiple research workstreams simultaneously.

title: Senior Front-End Engineer
description:
Role Overview

Our client is looking for a Senior Front-End Engineer to take ownership of their web platform and help define the next generation of user experience across the entire product catalog. This is a lead role for a self-starter who thrives in a startup environment, enjoys building beautifully engineered products, and knows how to translate AI and computer vision outputs into compelling visual experiences.

In this role, you’ll work directly with the Head of Product, the Design team, and Engineering teams to improve and expand the existing Inspection Platform, while leading front-end development for upcoming features across the broader product suite. You’ll collaborate closely with backend and ML engineers, bring your own ideas to the table, and be expected to leverage modern AI coding tools (ChatGPT, Claude, Copilot, etc.) to accelerate development, productivity, and testing.

You’ll also play a key role in shaping the user experience and human-centered design efforts as the platform evolves. This includes working closely with customers to gather feedback, validate workflows, and continuously improve usability across the product. Strong experience collaborating deeply with designers is essential.

As the front-end owner across the company, you’ll be responsible for defining and maintaining front-end frameworks, tooling, and workflows, establishing best practices, and organizing a reusable, well-documented component library. Your work will enable other front-end engineers to efficiently leverage existing patterns and components as the team grows. This is an ideal role for someone who wants to be the go-to front-end leader at a growing AI startup.

Key Responsibilities:

Own the front-end development and evolution of our client’s product suite

Lead front-end UI development and ensure consistency across multiple products

Translate AI and computer vision outputs (segmentation masks, bounding boxes, JSON metadata) into rich, high-performance web visualizations

Build, maintain, and document a component library using ShadCN, Radix UI, Tailwind, and Storybook in collaboration with visual designers

Collaborate daily with backend engineers and designers to ensure usability, scalability, and design consistency

Work closely with backend and ML teams to integrate APIs, model outputs, and data pipelines into the front-end experience

Bring creative ideas to improve UX and developer experience, from prototyping new views to optimizing rendering performance

Leverage AI-assisted workflows (ChatGPT, Claude Code, Copilot, etc.) to increase velocity, improve test coverage, and enhance code quality

Participate in roadmap planning, scoping sessions, and internal reviews as the front-end lead

Partner closely with the Design team to apply human-centered design principles and ensure workflows are intuitive and grounded in real customer needs

Participate in and help run customer-facing UAT sessions alongside design and product teams

Translate customer feedback and usability findings into concrete front-end improvements and iterative design enhancements

Support visual design execution when appropriate, ensuring high-quality UI implementation aligned with product and brand standards

Minimum Qualifications

7+ years of front-end development experience; 2+ years in a senior or lead role preferred

Deep expertise in React (Next.js) and TypeScript

Proven ability to integrate and visualize AI/ML outputs (JSON metadata, segmentation, bounding boxes, etc.) in scalable web interfaces

Experience solving Google Maps–style visualization challenges, including zoom logic and dynamic repositioning of text, icons, and overlays

Strong experience with Tailwind, Radix UI, ShadCN, and Storybook

Excellent collaboration skills and comfort working directly with product and design teams

Ability to work autonomously in a fast-paced startup environment

Strong understanding of human-centered design principles

Excellent written and spoken English, with the ability to communicate clearly with cross-functional teams and customers

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with GIS platforms such as ArcGIS (ESRI)

Background in computer vision or AI-powered SaaS products

Familiarity with cloud environments (AWS, Azure) and backend API integration

Active use of AI development tools (ChatGPT, Claude, Copilot, Cursor, etc.)

Experience defining or contributing to design systems

Passion for building products with real-world impact (climate resilience, infrastructure safety, etc.)

Hands-on experience with UX research, usability testing, or customer research

Visual design experience or strong UI sensibility (not required, but a big plus)

Education

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field required

A Master’s degree is preferred but not required; equivalent practical experience and a strong portfolio of shipped products are equally valued

Work Environment

Our client is a remote-first company, with a primary base in Los Angeles, CA. They support flexible remote work, allowing team members to work from wherever they are most productive. At the same time, they value in-person connection and host multiple all-hands offsite meetings each year to foster collaboration and team cohesion. The environment balances remote flexibility with in-person moments that matter, supporting a connected and high-performing global team.

description:
Sobre a Empresa

A Bizup Strategy é uma consultoria especializada em estratégia de crescimento e M&A, atuando lado a lado com fundadores, CEOs, executivos e investidores em decisões que realmente criam valor. Estamos organizados em equipes (células estratégicas) com especialização por indústria, com equipes compostas por estrategistas sêniores (provenientes de carreira executiva C-Level) e jovens talentos (com experiência em consultoria). Resumo da Função

Buscamos um profissional com forte base analítica, curiosidade intelectual e vontade real de aprender como negócios são transformados para crescer. O profissional terá exposição direta em atividades de prospecção de projetos e atuação em projetos.

Principais Atividades e Responsabilidades

1. Execução de Projetos e Estratégia

  • Participar ativamente de todas as etapas do trabalho de consultoria: estruturação de problemas estratégicos empregando metodologias proprietárias e ferramentas estratégicas de mercado, coleta e análise de dados, desenvolvimento de hipóteses e síntese de recomendações.
  • Participação em reuniões com clientes desde o início do projeto (tomar notas, organizar informações, preparar materiais pré e pós-reunião).
  • Atuar em projetos de transformação de empresas para venda (sell side) e processos de M&A.
  • Construir modelos financeiros, análises de valuation e business cases.
  • Traduzir dados e análises em recomendações claras e acionáveis.

2. Análise e Tratamento de Dados

  • Coletar dados de mercado, financeiros e operacionais.
  • Tratar bases de dados em Excel, Google Sheets ou ferramentas analíticas.
  • Construir visualização de dados (dashboards) e análises descritivas (por exemplo, crescimento, margem, custos, KPIs).

3. Pesquisa e Benchmark

  • Realizar pesquisas setoriais, competitivas e regulatórias.
  • Mapear concorrentes, tendências e boas práticas de mercado.

4. Estruturação de Apresentações

  • Criar slides claros e estruturados no PowerPoint, focados em impacto visual e clareza.

  • Colaborar na elaboração de propostas comerciais.
  • Atualizar bases internas de conhecimento e benchmarks. 
  • Registrar atividades e dados em ferramenta de CRM.

Requisitos do Perfil Desejado

a) Formação e Experiência:

  • Formação: Superior completo (com até 3 anos de formado) em Engenharia, Economia, Administração, Ciências da Computação, Agronomia, Química ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência: Mínimo de 12 meses (incluindo estágio) em consultoria, estratégia ou planejamento.
  • Idioma: Inglês avançado.

b) Habilidades Técnicas (Hard Skills):

  • Ferramentas: Office avançado, noções de Python e software de análise de dados (preferencialmente Power BI), para construção de dashboards e análises descritivas.
  • Capacidade Analítica: Forte raciocínio lógico estruturado para analisar dados quantitativos e qualitativos utilizando ferramentas de tecnologia, linguagens de programação e automação.

c) Competências Comportamentais (Soft Skills):

  • Boa comunicação verbal e escrita.
  • Capacidade de aprender rápido, lidar com ambiguidade e assumir responsabilidade.
  • Organização, disciplina e atenção aos detalhes.
  • Autonomia e foco em resultados.
  • Competência para trabalhar em equipe, colaborando no planejamento e troca de ideias.

d) Disponibilidade:

· Trabalho majoritariamente remoto, mas com disponibilidade para viagens e reuniões presenciais quando necessário.

e) Requisitos Desejáveis:

  • Conhecimento Técnico/Funcional: Noções de temas “cross-industry” tais como marketing , supply chain , pricing , finanças ou TI.
  • Conhecimento de princípios norteadores e processos de M&A.

O que oferecemos

  • Ambiente enxuto, meritocrático e intelectualmente exigente.
  • Mentoria próxima e feedback constante.
  • Remuneração competitiva com o mercado.

Vagas

A Bizup Strategy está com vagas para:

  • Célula de Manufatura Avançada
  • Célula de Serviços e Tecnologia
  • Célula de Agrobusiness e Química: Requisitos específicos para esta célula são a experiência ou vivência no agronegócio (insumos, agroindústria, distribuição, alimentos, bioenergia, etc).

Esta posição não impacta o desenvolvimento de aplicações, mas influencia significativamente as estratégias e operações de automação.”

  • Prestar suporte na instalação e configuração de produtos de automação da IBM.

Quais são as habilidades obrigatórias e níveis de proficiência exigidos para esta posição?

  • Experiência em Operações de Mainframe: Mínimo de 5+ anos em ambiente de operações de mainframe, em funções operacionais, de serviços, consultoria ou suporte.
  • IBM Tivoli Systems Automation for z/OS: Conhecimento avançado e experiência prática.

  • JCL: Fortes habilidades em Job Control Language.
  • Programação REXX: Capacidade de escrever e manter scripts REXX.
  • System Automation Policy Database (PDB): Conhecimento prático obrigatório.
  • Experiência em Migração: Histórico comprovado em projetos de migração de automação em z/OS.
  • NetView for z/OS: Experiência na implementação e utilização deste produto.
  • Scripting REXX: Avançado.

Quais são as habilidades opcionais e níveis de proficiência desejáveis para esta posição?

  • Conhecimento de outros softwares IBM Z, incluindo operação, configuração e automação de sistemas.
  • Familiaridade com processos de inicialização e desligamento do sistema z/OS.
  • Experiência com SMP/E para instalação e manutenção de software.
  • Entendimento de produtos de automação concorrentes no ecossistema de mainframe.
  • Especialização em configurações de sistemas totalmente automatizados em IBM Z.

title: AWS Data Architect
description:
About the Role

AWS Data Architect – Hybrid Cloud, Data Migration & Legacy Modernization

We are seeking an AWS Data Architect with deep expertise in hybrid cloud environments, on-prem to AWS migrations, ETL modernization, and legacy application analysis. This role will lead the transformation of multiple traditional on-premise systems—including databases, applications, ETL pipelines, and BI workloads—into modern, scalable cloud architectures.

You will work across several business verticals (HR, Corporate Finance, and Real Estate), collaborating closely with Cloud Engineering, Cloud Operations, BI, Data, and Application teams. The ideal candidate is hands-on, autonomous, and highly skilled at reverse-engineering systems in environments with little or no documentation.

Key Responsibilities

Cloud Architecture & Migration Strategy

· Lead end-to-end migration of on-prem systems (databases, applications, ETL, BI workloads) into AWS.

· Work with Oracle, SQL Server, ODI, legacy ETL flows, Java, Angular, OBIEE/OAS, SSRS, and BI Publisher.

· Define migration paths (lift-and-shift, re-platform, modernization).

· Architect AWS solutions leveraging services such as S3, Glue, Athena, DMS, EC2, Lambda, RDS/Aurora, IAM.

· Ensure data and application continuity for systems that remain on-prem.

· Contribute to data lake and analytical architecture design.

Legacy System Assessment

· Independently analyze and document complex legacy systems covering:

o Oracle & SQL Server structures, dependencies, logic, triggers, procedures.

o ODI mappings, packages, workflows, and transformations.

o Java and Angular applications and their data interactions.

o BI metadata layers and report logic (OBIEE/OAS, SSRS, BI Publisher).

o Batch processes, data flows, and integrations across HR, Finance, and Real Estate.

· Reverse-engineer systems with minimal support or documentation.

Hybrid Architecture & Data Synchronization

· Design architectures that span on-premise and AWS environments.

· Support scenarios where significant workloads remain on-prem.

· Build synchronization patterns for:

o On-prem ETL (ODI) sustaining local applications.

o Cloud ingestion for analytics and reporting.

· Ensure reliability and performance across hybrid data flows.

· Collaborate with infrastructure teams on Direct Connect, VPN, and related networking.

Data Engineering & ETL Modernization

· Translate business logic from Oracle/SQL Server into cloud-native technologies.

· Modernize ETL from ODI into AWS Glue, Python, SQL (Athena/PostgreSQL).

· Reimplement complex transformation rules while preserving business logic.

· Support semantic layer design, data modeling, and analytical datasets.

BI & Data Warehouse Migration

· Migrate BI workloads (OBIEE/OAS, SSRS, BI Publisher) into AWS.

· Rebuild and validate BI logic within cloud-based architectures.

· Apply data warehouse concepts (dimensional modeling, marts, semantic layers).

· Partner with BI teams on testing and rollout.

Compliance, Governance & Cloud Standards

· Operate within established cloud guardrails, IAM policies, and security frameworks.

· Ensure architecture aligns with organizational standards.

· Collaborate with Cloud Engineering and Cloud Operations for governance and infrastructure.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

· Engage with business analysts, data owners, and application teams.

· Work across diverse business domains with complex data landscapes.

· Maintain alignment with cloud, BI, data, and application initiatives.

Required Skills & Experience

Technical Expertise

· Strong experience designing hybrid cloud architectures (on-prem + AWS).

· Deep knowledge of Oracle and SQL Server, including advanced logic.

· Hands-on experience with ODI/ODEE and ETL reverse engineering.

· Experience with Tableau, Qlik, ThoughtSpot, or similar BI tools.

· Understanding of Java, Angular, and reporting/BI applications.

· Experience with OBIEE/OAS, SSRS, BI Publisher.

· Solid understanding of data modeling, data warehouse concepts, and analytical systems.

· Proficiency with AWS services: S3, Glue, Athena, DMS, EC2, Lambda, RDS/Aurora, IAM.

· Experience with hybrid connectivity (Direct Connect, VPN).

· Proficiency in Python.

Behavioral & Professional Skills

· Highly independent, resourceful, and comfortable with ambiguity.

· Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and critical thinking skills.

· Curious and proactive learner, able to master unfamiliar systems quickly.

· Hands-on, ownership-driven mindset.

· Strong communication and documentation capabilities.

· Ability to work across diverse business domains and technical stacks.

· Fluent English.

Nice to Have

· Exposure to financial or banking data domains.

· AWS Certifications: Solutions Architect, Data Engineer, Developer.

· Knowledge of Azure or other cloud providers in legacy environments.

Additional Information

· Work hours aligned to U.S. Eastern Time (EST).

· Remote from Brazil.

Why build your carrer at Meta?

We offer autonomy, clear goals and a dynamic and challenging environment, where professionals have the opportunity to interact with different technologies, participate in all types of projects, bring new ideas and work from anywhere in Brazil and (why not?) anywhere in the world. In addition, we are one of the best companies to work for in Brazil according to Great Place to Work and one of the 10 fastest growing technology companies in the country for 3 consecutive years, according to Anuário Informático Hoje.

What are our values?

- We are people serving people

- We all think and act like owners

- We are hungry for performance

- We grow and learn together

- We pursue excellence and simplicity

- We have innovation and creativity in our DNA

All people are welcome regardless of their condition, disability, ethnicity, religious belief, sexual orientation, appearance, age or others. We want you to grow up with us in a welcoming environment full of opportunities.

Did you relate? Then, #ComeBeMeta!

description:

About Your Team

Reporting to the Head of Data, you will collaborate with business and product teams to validate hypotheses, answer complex business questions, help the company in uncertain scenarios, perform data experiments, and disseminate actionable insights.

About You

You will take the lead in exploring data and cross-business variables, uncovering patterns and trends, identifying new data sources, and delivering valuable insights to various departments.

What You’ll Do:

  • Develop and execute complex data analyses using statistical techniques and modeling to validate business hypotheses.
  • Detect patterns, trends and anomalies in data and translate them into actionable insights that drive strategic decisions and business growth.
  • Serve as a key expert in data analysis, providing guidance and best practices to team members and stakeholders across the company.

What You’ll Bring:

  • 3+ years of experience within data analytics and/or data science.
  • Strong curiosity for uncovering insights from data.

Você irá atuar em um cliente multinacional de grande porte , do setor de petróleo e gás.

description:
Empresa de Engenharia, Fabricação de Equipamentos/Peças e Prestação de Serviços Especializados para o Setor de Extração/Refino de Óleos Vegetais

title: Translations Quality Assurance Coordinator
description:

title: Data / Sales Revenue Analyst
description:
Data / Sales Revenue Analyst

Location: Brazil (Remote)

About Sphise Technologies

Sphise Technologies is a global outsourcing and talent solutions company, partnering with high-growth businesses to build strong, high-impact teams across finance, technology, and operations.

For one of our clients, a mid-sized company operating at scale, we are currently looking to hire a Data / Sales Revenue Analyst

About the Role

We are looking for a Data / Sales Revenue Analyst with strong experience in building, maintaining, and scaling Tableau dashboards to support commercial, sales, and revenue decision-making. This role sits at the intersection of data analytics, sales performance, and business intelligence .

An FP&A or finance background is not required , though exposure to revenue, pricing, or financial metrics is a significant plus.

Key Responsibilities

  • Data & Analytics: Design, build, and maintain advanced Tableau dashboards for sales performance, revenue trends, pipeline health, and forecasting.
  • Revenue & Sales Intelligence: Analyze revenue drivers and trends, and support Sales and RevOps teams with KPI tracking, funnel analysis, and performance insights .
  • Data Management: Work with multiple data sources (CRM, ERP, Databricks, SQL) to extract, transform, and validate data quality for analytics and reporting.
  • Stakeholder Collaboration: Present insights and recommendations to leadership and non-technical stakeholders , translating data into clear business outcomes.

Required Qualifications

• Must-Have:

3–7+ years of experience in data, sales, or revenue analysis

Expert-level Tableau skills , including dashboard design and data storytelling

Advanced SQL and hands-on experience working in Databricks environments

Strong understanding of sales and revenue metrics (pipeline, conversion, growth, retention)

• Nice-to-Have:

Exposure to FP&A, pricing, or financial analysis

Experience with Salesforce , Snowflake , or BigQuery

Familiarity with SaaS, RevOps, or data-driven commercial environments

Benefits:

  • Competitive salary to recognise and reward your achievements.
  • Flexible work environment.
  • Opportunities for professional and personal growth.

title: Senior Client Success Manager
description:
Senior Client Success Manager

We are looking for a full-time, remote Senior Client Success Manager with 7+ years of experience working in a software, technical recruiting, or technical outsourcing client services role. This role combines client advocacy with revenue responsibilities, focusing on retention and growth within existing client accounts.

This individual will build loyalty and long-term engagement with our clients driving strategy and execution within client retention programs, account reviews, health checks, cross-sales, issue resolution, interview management, KPI tracking and administration, and more.

Reporting to the Head of Client Success, you will advocate for the client across all of Velozient and will play an integral role in our service delivery team.

Responsibilities

  • Develop strong client relationships built on high responsiveness and advocacy
  • Serve as the primary owner of account growth plans, including retention, expansion, and long-term account value
  • Identify and close new sales opportunities within existing accounts, build job descriptions when necessary, and kick off new job recruiting efforts
  • Plan and execute successful client retention programs that drive loyalty and satisfaction measured by NPS and CSAT respectively
  • Review and submit candidates for open client jobs
  • Coordinate candidate interviews and gather feedback communicating next steps within the People Success (a.k.a., recruiting) and Account Management teams
  • Collaborate with account managers on key account activity
  • Conduct client onboarding sessions
  • Perform periodic health checks and ensure new resources are onboarded successfully with the client
  • Collaborate with People Success in investigating and resolving resource issues
  • Provide needed service information to clients including resource holiday calendars and answer general client inquiries
  • Coordinate and contribute to annual account review preparation and execution
  • Exhibit high integrity, a self-starter approach, and commitment to owning work outcomes

Required Experience

  • Excellent English verbal and written communication skills with the ability to lead executive-level conversations
  • 7+ years of experience in Client Success, Account Management, Client Services, or a related customer-facing role within recruiting, staffing, SaaS, or professional services environments focused on software/technology
  • Understanding of software development lifecycle (SDLC) process and related technical roles
  • Proven ability to build and maintain long-term, trusted client relationships across multiple stakeholder levels, including senior leadership
  • Proven experience growing revenue within existing client accounts through cross selling or account expansion
  • Strong background conducting client onboarding, health checks, and business reviews to ensure successful outcomes and long-term engagement
  • Experience collaborating closely with Sales, Recruiting/Delivery, Operations, and Finance teams to drive client success and account growth
  • Data-driven approach to managing accounts, including tracking KPIs, NPS, CSAT, retention, hiring velocity, and revenue growth
  • Comfort managing complex client environments, navigating change, resolving issues, and balancing client advocacy with business objectives
  • Strong, innate desire to advocate for the client
  • Strong organizational skills, accountability, attention to detail, and multi-tasking background
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite (i.e., Outlook, Excel, Word, and PowerPoint)
  • Self-motivated, results-oriented, accountable, and trustworthy

Preferred Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in business, marketing, computer science, or a related field
  • Experience selling IT, software development, or outsourcing services
  • Experience working with Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS) and Customer Relationship Management (CRM) systems

Additional Information

  • Enjoy a fun, fast-growing entrepreneurial company, and work with smart and creative people
  • Be part of a highly collaborative learning culture - share knowledge, be inclusive, learn and grow together. Embrace teamwork!
  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter - think big!
  • Making mistakes is human - lets learn from them - be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual - no presumptions or judgment
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), 1 floating day, 3 sick days, and designated national holidays

About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software engineering company providing outsourced software resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer engineering talent that enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building and delivering software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued client team members. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: Senior US Immigration Paralegal
description:
Job Title: US. Employment-Based Immigration Paralegal

Location: Remote

Job Type: Full-Time

Company: Versfeld & Hugo, LLC

Versfeld & Hugo, LLC is seeking a detail-oriented and motivated Employment-Based Immigration Paralegal to join our growing practice. This role is critical to supporting attorneys and clients through all stages of the employment-based immigration process. The ideal candidate is organized, responsive, and experienced in managing immigration matters with precision and professionalism.

Responsibilities:

• Client Communication: Maintain regular contact with clients to provide case updates, respond to inquiries, and request required information and documentation.

• Email & Correspondence Management: Monitor and respond to client and internal emails promptly, ensuring accuracy, professionalism, and clarity in all written communications.

• Form & Petition Preparation: Prepare, review, and complete employment-based immigration forms, petitions, and applications with a high level of attention to detail to minimize errors and delays.

• Phone Communication: Return client calls in a timely manner and provide clear, accurate information while maintaining a courteous and professional demeanor.

• Document Management: Compile, organize, and maintain legal documents and supporting evidence for immigration filings.

• Case Management & Deadlines: Assist attorneys with managing case files, tracking deadlines, and monitoring case progress using internal case management systems.

• Legal Research: Stay current on employment-based immigration laws, regulations, and procedural updates to support accurate case preparation and client guidance.

Qualifications:

• Prior experience as an immigration paralegal or in a related immigration support role required.

• Bachelor’s degree preferred.

• Strong organizational skills and exceptional attention to detail.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

• Ability to work independently, manage competing deadlines, and prioritize tasks effectively in a remote environment.

• Familiarity with L1, O1, H1B, EB1A, and PERM is strongly preferred.

• Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite and immigration case management software.

Working Hours:

This is a full-time position with working hours from 9:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. Central Time, providing flexibility for work-life balance.

Salary and Benefits:

Compensation for this position is commensurate with experience and qualifications. In addition to salary, we offer a 401(k) retirement plan and provide a monthly stipend toward medical insurance, supporting both long-term financial planning and healthcare needs

How to Apply:

If you are a dedicated and detail-oriented professional who is passionate about immigration law and helping clients achieve their immigration goals, we would love to hear from you. Please send your resume to

Join our team at Versfeld & Hugo, LLC and make a meaningful impact on the lives of our clients by guiding them through the immigration process. We look forward to welcoming you to our team!

title: Remote Business Analyst (Portuguese) - 54880
description:
About Turing:

Turing is one of the world’s fastest-growing AI companies accelerating the advancement and deployment of powerful AI systems.

Turing helps customers in two ways: Working with the world’s leading AI labs to advance frontier model capabilities in thinking, reasoning, coding, agentic behavior, multimodality, multilinguality, STEM and frontier knowledge; and leveraging that work to build real-world AI systems that solve mission-critical priorities for companies.

Role Overview:

We are looking for candidates with strong analytical and English comprehension skills. The ideal candidate should have the ability to read, summarize, and break down large content into smaller logical blocks, conduct research online, validate claims made in the content through online research, and work with the LLM (Large Language Models) to solve puzzles!

Your role is critical in helping fine-tune and improve large language models (like gpt), and will make you an expert on how to leverage AI to be a better analyst. This is your chance to future-proof your career in an AI-first world!

What does day-to-day look like:

You would spend time answering a variety of interesting analytical questions and creating scenarios that can train the LLM models to get better. Here are a couple of examples which models might get wrong and you would have to give the correct answer and explanation to enable the models to learn:

  • Based on a given distribution of sales by month across locations, could you analyze which location has grown the most? (Hint: what time period should we look at? should we account for sudden variability at the beginning?)
  • In a small town, there are four distinct neighborhoods: Oak, Pine, Maple, and Elm. A postman is assigned to deliver mail and can only deliver to two neighborhoods in one day, with certain rules (e.g. Oak is always visited before Pine). If he delivers to Oak and Elm on the first day, which neighborhoods does the carrier deliver to on the second day? Note: No other prior specialized domain experience is needed.

Requirements:

  • Multilingual capabilities are mandatory. (English and Portuguese)
  • Analytical Skills : Good research and analytical skills
  • Feedback Skills : Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations.
  • Creative Thinking : Creative and lateral thinking abilities.
  • Communication : Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Independence : Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting.
  • Commitment : Ability to commit to 40 hours per week for the contract duration overlapping US hours.
  • Technical Setup : Desktop/Laptop set up with a good internet connection.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Bachelors degree or undergraduate in Engineering, Literature, Journalism, Communications, Arts, Statistics, or a related field. We are open to candidates who do not have a Bachelor's degree but have experience in the area.
  • Experience writing professionally (business analysts, research analyst, copywriter, journalist, technical writer, editor, translator, etc.)
  • Understanding of Excel and Google Suite.
  • Proficiency in Data interpretation, Logical reasoning and Basic arithmetic is highly desirable.

Benefits:

  • Competitive compensation based on experience and expertise.
  • Flexible working hours and remote work environment.
  • Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies.
  • Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.

Offer Details:

  • Engagement type : Contractor assignment/freelancer (no medical/paid leave)
  • This role will require some overlap with UTC-8:00 (2-5 hrs/day) America/Los_Angeles

Know amazing talent? Refer them at turing.com/referrals , and earn money from your network.
